name: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: The write performed by `write_volatile` must not race with any read or write of the same location from another thread; volatile accesses are non-atomic and cannot be used for inter-thread synchronization.
api: unsafe fn write_volatile < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides no observations of other threads’ accesses or temporal overlap needed to express a data race.
